Sections.Name: General
Sections.Description: Development build with persistent population and scheduled street visits. Families and interior activity are still in development.

Keys.Name: Enabled
Keys.Description: Enable population updates. Disabling keeps saved residents and deaths; schedules catch up when re-enabled.

Keys.Name: StreetPopulation
Keys.Description: Gothway Garden prototype: scheduled adult visits and interior presence using classic sprites. Replaces random street civilians while active; keeps existing guards. Beds, families and reactions remain unfinished.

Sections.Name: Population
Sections.Description: Changes affect initial allocation in newly visited settlements. Existing households remain intact.

Keys.Name: HouseholdLimit
Keys.Description: Maximum permanent residents per new household. Visitors will use separate limits when implemented.

Sections.Name: DailyRoutine
Sections.Description: Hours use the 24-hour clock. Currently controls virtual home/sleep schedules; changes apply immediately.

Keys.Name: SleepHour
Keys.Description: Hour residents go to sleep at home.

Sections.Name: Diagnostics
Sections.Description: Development controls. These affect diagnostic refresh, not walking speed.

Keys.Name: RefreshSeconds
Keys.Description: Seconds between settlement and diagnostic updates.

Keys.Name: EnableF8Panel
Keys.Description: Allow F8 to toggle the population diagnostic panel.
